producer_metadata.locator_handling: String data only; the reader never fetches or executes locator values.

run.description: Execute caller-supplied argv once in the explicit workspace and write a bounded receipt of observed facts.
run.argv_boundary: Arguments after -- are passed directly to subprocess with shell=false.
run.child_context: The child inherits the caller environment and permissions. It is not sandboxed, and this component imposes no child network or workspace-write restriction.
run.receipt_write: Writes a new receipt beneath the explicit workspace; refuses to overwrite an existing receipt.
run.exit_semantics: Exit 0 means a receipt was written, even if the child failed or timed out. Invocation, preflight, or receipt-write errors exit 2; inspect the receipt for the child outcome.
records: actual launch/completion status, child exit code or timeout
caller-declared input identities before and after the command
caller-declared artifact identities after the command

check.description: Read-only comparison of an explicit receipt and the caller-repeated declared scope against current workspace file identities.
check.receipt_data: Receipt strings are data; the check never executes or replays command argv or other receipt values.
check.exit_semantics: Readable MATCH, MISMATCH, UNBOUND, and INDETERMINATE outcomes exit 0; malformed/tampered receipts and invocation errors exit 2.

scope.binding: BOUND only when at least one input is declared. Artifact-only and empty scopes are UNBOUND while preserving execution and available artifact facts.
scope.path_policy: Scope paths are relative to the explicit workspace; traversal, ambiguous paths, and link/reparse-point components are rejected.
scope.identity_rule: A clean MATCH requires a matching declared scope and present, stable identities for every recorded/current input and artifact. Missing, changed, unsafe, or unverifiable identities are not clean matches.

limits.stdout_stderr_encoding: Retained bytes are decoded as UTF-8 with replacement; captures are not byte-exact for arbitrary output.

security_and_privacy.warning: argv and retained stdout/stderr may contain secrets. Avoid passing secrets or sensitive output.

claim_boundary: The receipt preserves bounded local execution and declared-file identity facts only. It does not establish dependency completeness, no intermediate mutation, process-read tracing, correctness, authenticated provenance, permission, external truth, safety, or authority.
